comparisons.peer_topic: 2023 Equity Incentive Plan Approval and Share Reservations
comparisons.peer_summary: On May 18, 2023, the Company approved the AMD 2023 Equity Incentive Plan, which supersedes the Prior Plans, with 87,645,874 shares reserved for future awards. As of December 28, 2024, 60 million shares were available for future grants, and 34 million shares were reserved for issuance upon exercise or vesting.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and NVDA disclose the number of shares remaining available for future grants under their equity incentive plans at the end of fiscal year 2024. NVDA reported 147 million shares available as of January 28, 2024, while AMD reported 60 million shares available as of December 28, 2024. Both disclosures confirm the availability of shares for future equity awards, though the absolute volumes differ significantly.

sentences.text: As of January 28, 2024 and January 29, 2023, there were 147 million and 160 million shares, respectively, of common stock available for future grants under our equity incentive plans.
